# Entity Details

Founded: 1990s (Over 30 years of engineering field experience)

# Core Competencies & Capabilities
- MEP Contracting: Full-spectrum Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing engineering.
- HVAC & Ventilation: Cleanrooms, VRV/VRF, chillers, ductwork fabrication, air balancing, commercial AC.
- Fire Fighting & Life Safety: NBC 2016 compliant hydrant networks, automated sprinkler systems, pump rooms, deluge systems, fire alarm detection.
- Electrical Systems: HT/LT electrical panels, transformers, distribution boards, load planning, industrial power wiring.
- Cold Rooms & Cold-Chain: Commercial & industrial refrigeration engineering, temperature/humidity controlled rooms, PUFF panel installation.
- Water Purification: Industrial and commercial Reverse Osmosis (RO) plants, filtration, softening systems.
- Fabrication: Custom sheet metal ducting, pipe racks, structural steel framing.
- Solar Energy: Commercial & industrial grid-tied and hybrid photovoltaic solar power systems.

# Key Projects & Track Record
- Sevakunj Hospital LNCT, Indore: Complete SITC Fire and Safety system, piping, and pump room.
- IIT Indore: SITC HVAC Systems and Fire & Safety suppression systems.
- Vitamax Healthcare, Pithampur: Pharma lab PUFF panel cleanroom construction with integrated HVAC system.
- LK City, Indore: SITC Gas distribution lines.
- Bhartiya Enterprises, Indore: Commercial cold room storage system for dates and perishable goods.
- JK Hospital LNCT, Bhopal: SITC Fire and Safety network.
